title: Fake video about Zelenskyy’s parents – level 2
paragraphs: A viral video on social media falsely claims that the parents of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy are in trouble for corrupt money. The video uses the logo of a famous news channel, but the story is completely fake.

Fact-checkers found that Euronews didn’t make this video, and the voice in it was made by AI. Ukrainian officials explained that this video is part of Russian propaganda to share fake news. The main goal of these fake stories is to make people around the world lose trust in Ukraine and stop helping the country. There were many similar fake reports about the Zelenskyy family before

words.d: information and ideas which want to influence people’s political opinions
the belief that something is good, honest, or safe
